pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown patches exhibit high-frequency jagged edge serrations with sharp pixel gradients. The shapes are non-uniform and stellate, featuring multiple angular projections into the negative space.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The network of light cream-colored corridors forms a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are clearly defined where 3 to 4 corridors intersect. The pixel width of these pathways is relatively consistent throughout the visible flank region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck presents a short, stiff, and densely packed serrated 1D profile with high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks visible against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Two small birds (oxpeckers) are perched on the upper neck and mid-dorsal ridge, creating localized visual occlusions of the pelage and mane.
